- **Difference between the two values**: The Form 4/A filed on 9/30 states the post-transaction share count as 460,624,307. This differs from the 13G/A by 3,009,623 shares. Because the original does not explain the basis of calculation (scope of direct and indirect ownership), both values are listed and not reconciled (source: ① [Form 4/A](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000121390026105393/xslF345X06/ownership.xml), 2026-09-30).
- **Judgment layer**: This is an update to a filing of holdings of 5% or more. It is not subject to a rule or milestone. It is used only as background for observing trading volume and share price during the T2 (12/8 lock-up) period (source: `state.triggers_next_12m[T2]`).
